evidence.content: services.yaml defines: portless (proxy on :1355), web (portless web.platform with PORTLESS_APP_PORT=4310), storybook (bash apps/storybook/scripts/start-portless.sh). Both web and storybook depend_on portless. Healthchecks use Portless URLs.

evidence.label: Storybook Portless URL
evidence.description: Storybook loads successfully at http://storybook.platform.localhost:1355 — shows Storybook 10 sidebar with Primitives (Button, Card, Checkbox, Input), Docs page for Button with controls table.

evidence.label: Web Portless URL

VAL-CROSS-003.reason: Both Portless routes exist simultaneously (confirmed via `portless list`). Storybook loads fully at its Portless URL. Web app loads at its Portless URL (the React re-render error is a pre-existing app-level issue, not a Portless concern — the route works and serves the Next.js surface). Both services have committed startup paths in .factory/services.yaml with explicit Portless integration and dependency declarations.
